What is a Controlling Post? A controlling post number identifies an account or customer record and is used for distribution of reports and online information within the Retail network. A controlling post is a five character code. The first character is a letter indicating the post category; the other four characters are numeric.
A - Collections / Hardship / Lending Services F & L - Retail, Small Business (Retail) P - Private Bank R, W - Small Business - Managed
CustomField.label: Controlling Post
